Mar 2024 • Couples
Our culinary adventure in Ho Chi Minh City took us to Banh Xeo 46A, a modest spot brimming with Vietnamese culture. Located in a lively neighborhood, this eatery is famous for its banh xeo, and it certainly lived up to its reputation. The outdoor tables were bustling with guests, creating a vibrant atmosphere.

As we arrived, the sounds of sizzling batter and the aroma of fresh herbs and pork filled the air. The banh xeo, a crispy rice flour crepe stuffed with pork and bean sprouts, was a highlight. The real delight was wrapping the banh xeo in lettuce with herbs and dipping it in nuoc cham, a tangy sauce that tied all the flavors together.

The experience was as much about the lively setting as it was about the food. Watching the skilled cooks expertly handle the crepes added a touch of theater to our meal. The friendly staff and the vibrant energy of the place made our dinner at Banh Xeo 46A memorable. Michelin-rated for a reason, this spot is a must-visit for anyone seeking authentic Vietnamese flavors in Ho Chi Minh City.
